method: Claude applied docs/MIMMA_RUBRIC.md to each game: main mode, competent player, steps of 10. Recorded before any community data was analyzed. The owner v1 scores were already known.

micro.reason: Built around aim: crosshair placement, counter-strafing, and spray control decide most rounds, often in one or two shots.

meso.reason: Rounds turn on what you cannot see: positions, footsteps, fakes, utility baits, and guessing the enemy buy and site.

macro.reason: Economy across rounds and pre-round strategy and utility plans matter a lot, but gunfights decide more.

micro.reason: Throttle, brake, and steering control is the core interaction and matters in scenarios; free roam has no fail state.

meso.reason: AI traffic and crash physics add some unpredictability; nothing is hidden and nobody is outguessed.

macro.reason: Vehicle parts and tuning; few long-term decisions decide outcomes in a sandbox.

micro.reason: One-headshot kills, peeks, and recoil control decide gunfights.

meso.reason: Built around information: drones, cameras, roamers, sound through walls, and new angles opened by destruction.

macro.reason: Operator picks, site setup, and the attack plan are fixed before contact and decide many rounds.

micro.reason: Precision gunplay and movement matter often; hard raids and Grandmaster content punish misses, most PvE forgives them.

meso.reason: Enemy behavior is mostly predictable and raid encounters are learned scripts; loot rolls are random but do not change play.

macro.reason: Buildcrafting with subclass, armor mods, exotics, and weapon perks, plus loadouts per activity, decides encounters early.

micro.reason: Turn-based; it never asks for fast or precise inputs.

meso.reason: Every attack, save, and check is a d20 roll, with hidden traps and unknown outcomes; players plan around the odds.

macro.reason: Built around planning: party and multiclass builds, spell slots and rests, turn-by-turn tactics, long-term choices.

micro.reason: Recoil control, tracking aim over a long time-to-kill, and movement tech are the core of every fight.

meso.reason: Random loot and ring, unknown squad positions, and third parties: you act without full information constantly.

macro.reason: Rotations, zone reading, legend composition, and when to fight or leave decide placement.

micro.reason: Dodge and parry timing, spacing, and stamina against bosses; builds and summons can lower the demand.

meso.reason: Delayed and mixed boss attacks punish early reactions, and the world hides ambushes; retries make patterns learnable.

macro.reason: Stat allocation, weapon and spell builds, talismans, upgrades, and exploration routing shape every fight.

micro.reason: Shooting and dodging matter in boss fights and raids; most play forgives rough inputs.

meso.reason: Capture odds, passive-skill rolls, and raids add chance that matters sometimes.

macro.reason: The main loop is planning: base layout, work assignments, automation, tech order, and breeding.

micro.reason: Combos, positioning, and dodge, guard, and counter timing against a large monster decide hunts.

meso.reason: You read a monster's tells in the moment; rage states, turf wars, and weather vary it, but patterns are learnable.

macro.reason: Weapon and armor skill builds, decorations, item and meal prep, and crafting progression.

micro.reason: Aim and ability timing decide fights for most heroes; melee, beam, and support kits lower the demand.

meso.reason: Tracking enemy ultimates and cooldowns, flank timing, and baits; most information is on screen.

macro.reason: Team composition, counter-picks, team-ups, and ultimate economy are planned ahead of fights.
